ننتخب (form VIII)
# نَنْتَخِبُ (nantaḵibu) /nan.ta.xi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# نُنْتَخَبُ (nuntaḵabu) /nun.ta.xa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# نَنْتَخِبَ (nantaḵiba) /nan.ta.xi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# نُنْتَخَبَ (nuntaḵaba) /nun.ta.xa.ba/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
